title: What is the simulation-to-reality gap?
summary: Success in simulation may not transfer to the real environment.
body: It is the difference between performance inside a generated or simulated environment and performance under real conditions. Sensor noise, lighting, weather, wear, human behaviour and edge cases can cause systems that succeed in simulation to fail after deployment.
